articles.title: Progressive Doctor Wins Michigan Senate Primary in a Nail-Biter
articles.summary: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed, a progressive who wants Medicare for all, narrowly won Michigan's Democratic Senate primary. He'll face Trump-backed Mike Rogers in November.

articles.title: LIV Golf Finds a Mystery Investor to Save the League After Saudi Money Dries Up
articles.summary: LIV Golf has a new 'lead investor' to replace Saudi Arabia's funding. The deal will make players majority owners—a first for a big sports league.

articles.title: Michigan's Big Surprise: A Progressive Wins the Senate Race!
articles.summary: In Michigan, a progressive named Abdul El-Sayed beat a more moderate Democrat for the Senate nomination. He wants big changes like Medicare for All. But he'll face a tough Republican in November.
